reference: oneM2M TR-0084 (FL resource model; own wording)
simulatedComponents: dataset: documented synthetic task privacy-motion-8-heterogeneous-v1 (worker-private seeds)
compute time: trainDelayMs=800 per selected round to open a deterministic dropout window
transport: oneM2M HTTP binding to a real Mobius4 CSE over loopback (X-M2M-Origin/RI/RVI, rsc checked)

task.selectionPolicy: eligible = enrolled + consent ACTIVE + signed heartbeat fresh; order = least selected, then highest last base loss, then participantId; take maxParticipants; close at all updates or deadline; quorum minUpdates

dataset.oracleEvaluation: harness regenerates shards from provisioned seeds only for the comparison table; the coordinator never receives seeds or rows

resourceLayout.cseBaseAcp: /Mobius/acp-fl-privacy-motion-76388c (coordinator ALL, all DISCOVERY; AE acpi from creation)
children: rounds/r-NNNN/{config cin, updates cnt, result cin}

baselines.note: same pooled test split (4 x 120 rows) and same numerics, computed in the harness process; centralized pools all 4 train splits (needs raw data transfer, reference upper bound); static ideal fixes w1-w3 with no faults; static same-faults fixes w1-w3 and drops members that were ineligible, missing or rejected in the real round

sensitivity.method: in-process replay of the real run participation schedule (accepted sets per completed round) on 10 alternative shard seed sets; same numerics; not a CSE run

dataLocality.rule: no feature arrays and no row ids in any CSE content
